name: warboss-marketplace
description: The warboss horde: a model-aware delegation framework that routes work down a rank ladder by residual entropy — expensive model decides, cheapest model does.

plugins.name: warboss-horde
plugins.description: A config-driven model ladder (N models = N rungs) plus a /delegate doctrine that routes each slice to the cheapest rung that can satisfy it: one generic `doer` dispatched at the chosen model, a cheap `runner` for verify commands and ops, prework that converts unjudgeable slices into judgeable ones, and automatic per-dispatch metering.
